record.reason: The paper studies decentralized diffusion-model denoising experts and finds sparse Top-2 routing gives better generation quality than full expert aggregation. Its domain is image diffusion and expert/data alignment, not LLM serving or inference cost.
record.title: Expert-Data Alignment Governs Generation Quality in Decentralized Diffusion Models
